Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică

Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale, Fabricația de mase plastice și Fabricația de ambalaje și recipiente
What You Will Enjoy Doing
 Application Support & Operations
Provide first, second- and third-level support for the corporate application landscape, including incident analysis, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and ticket resolution.
Monitor application availability, performance, interfaces, and scheduled jobs to ensure stable and reliable daily operations.
Coordinate and support application-related changes, releases, updates, and deployments in collaboration with business departments, IT teams, and external service providers.
Manage user access requests, application configurations, and operational support activities in accordance with corporate standards.
 Application Lifecycle Management
Support the complete application lifecycle, including documentation, testing, configuration, release management, and handover from projects into operations.
Analyze recurring incidents and identify opportunities for automation, standardization, process optimization, and continuous improvement.
Ensure operational readiness and supportability of new applications and system enhancements.
 Stakeholder & Vendor Management
Collaborate with infrastructure, security, integration, and development teams on technical topics such as interfaces, authentication, databases, hosting environments, and system integrations.
Maintain operational documentation, support procedures, knowledge base articles, and user communication in English.
Act as the primary contact for business stakeholders, regional IT teams, key users, and external vendors to ensure timely resolution of operational and support-related topics.
Coordinate vendor support activities and escalate issues where necessary to ensure agreed service levels are met.
 What makes you great
 Job Holder Profile
University degree in Information Technology, Business Informatics, Business Administration, or a comparable qualification.
Minimum 3 years of experience in application support, application operations, business application management, or a related field.
Good understanding of enterprise application landscapes, integrations, databases, user management, and infrastructure dependencies.
Experience with incident, problem, and change management processes, preferably in an ITIL-oriented environment.
Basic understanding of Windows Server environments, application hosting, monitoring solutions, and interface technologies is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to coordinate activities across multiple technical and business teams.
Ability to translate business requirements into clear and actionable IT solutions.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Strong customer and service orientation with the ability to work effectively in a global environment.
Structured, hands-on, and self-driven working style.
Stand-by willingness to support during outside of office hours.
Flexibility and willingness to support international projects and global stakeholders.
 It is required to act in a safe and environmentally responsible manner at all times by adhering to all ALPLA policies and procedures as well as Safety Standards (OSHA).
 What You Can Expect Working With Us
Responsible for the support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the global application landscape across Corporate Functions, including Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Sustainability, Strategy.
Ensure stable, reliable, and efficient application operations by resolving incidents, supporting end users, and coordinating technical topics with internal teams and external partners.
Act as the interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and infrastructure teams to translate business requirements into sustainable and scalable application solutions.
Promote standardization, documentation, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence across the global application environment, also with the help of AI and automization initiatives.
